app.Documentation: Main Streamlit application that handles user authentication, personality assessment, chat interface, and displays communication advice.

show_personality_form.Documentation: Displays the personality assessment form and returns the user's responses.

display_chat_interface.Documentation: Displays the chat interface for the given user ID.

get_communication_advice.Documentation: Retrieves communication advice based on the personalities of the two users.

register_user.Documentation: Registers a new user, saves their personality data to a JSON file, and returns the user ID.

login_user.Documentation: Logs in an existing user and returns the user ID if the username exists.

submit_assessment.Documentation: Receives personality assessment data, determines personality type, and returns user ID and personality type.

chat.request: dict (sender_id: str, receiver_id: str, message: str)
chat.Documentation: Handles real-time chat messages between users.

advice.Documentation: Generates communication advice based on the personalities of two users.

get_user_personality.Documentation: Retrieves the personality type of a user from their profile.

analyze_personality.Documentation: Analyzes the personality assessment data and determines the user's personality type.

generate_communication_advice.Documentation: Generates advice on how to communicate effectively between two personality types.

data/user_profiles.description: Stores user profiles, including username, password (hashed), personality type, and other relevant information.
